maddeler.e:
تعتزمون (form VIII)
# تَعْتَزِمُونَ (taʕtazimūna) /taʕ.ta.zi.muː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَزَمَ (iʕtazama)
# تُعْتَزَمُونَ (tuʕtazamūna) /tuʕ.ta.za.muː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَزَمَ (iʕtazama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
